about: Ausfam (famotidine), by brand name only, is supplied eight times from February to August 2026 to a 73-year-old man.
Ausfam (famotidine) 20 mg twice a day is supplied three times from 16 December 2025 to 13 February 2026, in the middle of a 14-month history, to a 67-year-old woman.

The only acid medicine is Somac Heartburn Relief (pantoprazole 20 mg), a proton pump inhibitor supplied as two 14-tablet packs about eight months apart, and no cimetidine, ranitidine or famotidine is supplied, so the criterion is not met.
